rules.statement: When several hosts each apply the same hardening setting, such as suppressing the Kestrel Server header, give every host that has an integration test project its own host-level test that builds that host and asserts the setting, for example `KestrelServerOptions.AddServerHeader == false`.
rules.why: If only one host is tested, another host can drop the call and start sending the header again without any test failing. A unit test of the registration doesn't catch a host that stops calling it.
rules.check: In a diff that adds or changes a hardening call in a host's Program.cs, check that each host making the call has a host-level test building that host and asserting the result. A test that builds only one of the hosts doesn't count for the others.
